<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  AccordionRoot,
  type AccordionRootEmits,
  type AccordionRootProps,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<AccordionRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<AccordionRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionRoot
    data-slot="accordion"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot />
  </AccordionRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { AccordionItem, type AccordionItemProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<AccordionItemProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionItem
    data-slot="accordion-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-accordion-item"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AccordionItem>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-accordion-item {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { AccordionHeader, AccordionTrigger, type AccordionTriggerProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<AccordionTriggerProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /** The trigger label. */
  default?: () => unknown;
  /** Replaces the chevron icon that rotates when the item opens. */
  icon?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionHeader class="sigma-ui-accordion-header">
    <AccordionTrigger
      data-slot="accordion-trigger"
      v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
      class="sigma-ui-accordion-trigger"
      :class="[$attrs.class]"
    >
      <slot />
      <slot name="icon">
        <svg
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="2"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
          class="sigma-ui-accordion-trigger-icon"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
        </svg>
      </slot>
    </AccordionTrigger>
  </AccordionHeader>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-accordion-header {
    display: flex;
  }

  .sigma-ui-accordion-trigger {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 4) 0;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .sigma-ui-accordion-trigger-icon {
    width: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: transform 0.2s;
  }

  .sigma-ui-accordion-trigger[data-state="open"] .sigma-ui-accordion-trigger-icon {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
  }
}
</style>
